title: DAY 5 — LESSONS 3–7: CONFLICT RESOLUTION AND HANDLING DIFFICULT SITUATIONS

questions.prompt: What is the best way to address a colleague's mistake?
options: Attack the colleague's personality
Identify the specific issue and expected improvement
Discuss the mistake with everyone

questions.prompt: What should you do when a colleague invites you to spread an unverified rumour?
options: Avoid participating and redirect genuine concerns appropriately
Share the rumour with trusted friends
Post it in the staff group
Following an agreed handover procedure
Respectfully asking for clarification
Deliberately withholding necessary work information because a colleague reported a concern

questions.prompt: When should an employee involve a supervisor?
options: Whenever a colleague disagrees with them
When a repeated problem remains unresolved or a serious concern requires intervention
Only after a public argument

questions.prompt: How should an immediate client safety concern be handled?
options: Address the danger and escalate promptly
Wait until the end of the week
Discuss it only with friends

questions.prompt: Why should individual disagreements generally be discussed privately when appropriate?
options: To prevent any official record
To avoid all accountability
To protect dignity and encourage constructive communication

questions.prompt: What should employees do during a private conflict-resolution conversation?
options: Listen, clarify facts and agree on practical next steps
Concentrate on proving who is superior
Bring unrelated past mistakes into the discussion

questions.prompt: What does moving forward after a disagreement require?
options: Becoming close personal friends
Maintaining appropriate professional cooperation and agreed improvements
Ignoring repeated misconduct

questions.prompt: What is the most reliable way to rebuild damaged trust?
options: Demand immediate forgiveness
Make promises without changing behaviour
Demonstrate consistent honesty, reliability and improvement

questions.prompt: Which statement best reflects Zura Spa's conflict-resolution expectations?
options: Address issues fairly, avoid retaliation, seek help when needed and maintain respect
Support friends regardless of the facts
Avoid reporting serious misconduct to preserve peace
